title: Explicit source and target Hom model factors
statement: Construct the source and target model isomorphisms for the normalized source-shift square. The input is F applied to the inverse Hom model at (P[a],I) followed by the source map of the localization shift isomorphism. The output is the (-a)-shift of the Hom map of the two localization factors followed by the Hom model at (KP,KI). These are actual composites of the recorded isomorphisms, with K-injectivity hypotheses on their targets [def-pod-reindexing-coherence-data].

lean.statement:
def sourceModelInput
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt] (s : Option ℕ)
    (P I : K l E Y s) (a : ℤ) [I.IsKInjective] :
    (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
        ((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj (hom l E Y s (P⟦a⟧) I)) ≅
      (podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g s).obj
        ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y s).obj
          (op (((podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj P)⟦a⟧), (podReindexingQ l E Y s).obj I))
